$ python3 /home/admin/diagnose.py --help
usage: diagnose.py [-h] [--version] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--url URL]
                   [--service SERVICE] [--expect-status EXPECT_STATUS]
                   [--expect-text EXPECT_TEXT] [--disk-path DISK_PATH]
                   [--min-free-percent MIN_FREE_PERCENT]
                   [--nginx-bin NGINX_BIN] [--checks CHECKS]
                   [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--output OUTPUT] [--text]

Health checks for a Linux web server. JSON report, exit code 0/1/2/3.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --host HOST           host for the port/http checks (default 127.0.0.1)
  --port PORT           TCP port (default 80)
  --url URL             URL for the http check (default http://HOST:PORT/)
  --service SERVICE     systemd unit name (default nginx)
  --expect-status EXPECT_STATUS
                        expected HTTP status (default 200)
  --expect-text EXPECT_TEXT
                        text that must appear in the HTTP body
  --disk-path DISK_PATH
                        path to check, repeatable (default /)
  --min-free-percent MIN_FREE_PERCENT
                        minimum free space in percent (default 10)
  --nginx-bin NGINX_BIN
                        nginx binary for the config check (default nginx)
  --checks CHECKS       comma separated list from:
                        service,port,http,disk,config (default
                        service,port,http,disk)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     timeout in seconds for every check (default 3)
  --output OUTPUT       also write the JSON report to this file
  --text                print a human readable summary instead of JSON
[exit code: 0]
